value.title: Il cielo dell'ambizione e le alte fiamme della battaglia
value.synopsis: Najica and Lila work as models for at a weapons aircraft event in order to look for a shady weapons dealer with a Humaritt named Tony. Their modeling takes publicity from a jealous company executive and his daughter. However, Tony later appears to steal that company's fighter plane, using the daughter as a hostage. Tony and Najica face each other in a dogfight, while Lila raids the dealer's ship.

value.title: La coraggiosa leonessa del deserto e la dea
value.synopsis: Najica and Liia travel to a country run by a ruthless queen to recover a Humaritt from a rebel militia group led by the queen's daughter.

value.title: La fine della battaglia e l'amore pericoloso
value.synopsis: Ninja-like girls tack down a couple on a train trip through the forest and it is up to Najica to protect them before it is too late.

value.title: La missione della triste separazione e la fanciulla dall'animo sincero
value.synopsis: Najica must recover a young male Humaritt from another Humaritt named X.

value.title: Il meraviglioso agente con la rosa di un incontro inatteso
value.synopsis: The creator of the Humaritts comes forth and explain the reason she created them.
